name: Explore a Career in IT Support
description: Eleven-course learning path from LinkedIn Learning covering PC maintenance and performance, computer hardware, Microsoft Entra ID, Windows 10 administration, security, networking, and troubleshooting. Completed all 11 courses (16 hours) to explore a career in IT support.

criteria.narrative: Completed all eleven courses in the Explore a Career in IT Support learning path on LinkedIn Learning: Learning PC Maintenance and Performance, Computer Components and Peripherals for IT Technicians, Microsoft Entra ID Fundamentals, Windows 10: Supporting Users Essential Training, Windows 10: Administration, Windows 10: Security, Windows 10: Networking, Troubleshooting Common PC Issues for Users, Windows 10 for IT Support: Troubleshooting Basics, IT Support for a Hybrid Workforce, and IT Service Desk Careers and Certifications.
